posts.post:
Fun fact: High-maintenance style is actually the most low-maintenance strategy.

When you buy intentional, well-made pieces, you stop needing to 'find' an outfit every morning.

Everything in your closet works with everything else.

You spend five minutes getting ready and look better than the person who spent two hours trying to style a trend.

Complexity is expensive. Simplicity is leverage.

You don’t need to be trendy. Just be intentional and people will assume you have it all figured out.

Most people are drowning in 'new' clothes that look dated in three weeks.

That is the cost of being an impulsive consumer.

Style isn't about what you add to your cart.

It’s about what you choose to leave out.

Pay off your ignorance debt. Buy better. Wear longer.
